study_identification_part.si4_title: Distinct Neurodevelopmental Patterns and Intermediate Integration-Based Predictive Modeling in Autism Spectral Disorder

study_characteristics_part.sc1_study_objective: Characterize age-related cortical developmental trajectories in ASD vs. TD across the lifespan, identify cortical biomarkers, and evaluate an intermediate-integration deep learning model (LMFGCN) for ASD classification.

rci9_site_effect_handling.detail: Compared GAMLSS model variants including sex and scanner site as fixed intercepts vs random effects; selected by AIC/BIC with 70/30 split. Additionally applied ComBat harmonization by site with covariates age and sex before ROI-wise group comparisons.

clinical_application_and_analysis_part.caa8_key_findings_brief: ASD shows distinct cortical developmental trajectories: early increased SA and GV with thinner CT, converging around 8–10 years then decreasing; LMFGCN outperforms alternative classifiers for ASD vs TD.
